case_universe.duplicate_policy: occurrences are not collapsed across paths; unique-label tables additionally collapse exact normalized values
case_universe.eligible_text: blob decodes as strict UTF-8, contains no NUL byte, and has byte_count <= 5000000
case_universe.generated_and_historical_policy: included when eligible text; provenance flags distinguish current, historical, generated, package, and test surfaces without removing them
case_universe.line_policy: LF-normalized decoding only for position calculation; raw blob SHA-256 and byte count bind original bytes
case_universe.tracked_blob_denominator: all blob entries at the frozen subject tree

comparators.claim_boundary: comparator agreement measures census mechanics only, not external semantic adjudication
comparators.donor_access: matched exact Git tree, CPU, memory, and parser libraries
comparators.ideal_donor_product: union of the strongest runnable detector and all frozen coordinate rules under identical source-tree access
comparators.strongest_runnable_donor: structured-key plus lexical detector with exact raw-context retention
comparators.terminal_only_donor: exact lexical census without coordinate decomposition

forbidden_inference: no scientific truth from label frequency
no empirical or external novelty authority
no paper or claim authority update
no scalar quality or readiness score
success_requires: every tracked blob classified as parsed_text or retained_exclusion
every extracted occurrence retained in the raw manifest
every unique label assigned to one or more frozen DES coordinates or retained unclassified
all family and classification denominators reconcile exactly
all CANNOT_CHECK, adverse, null, harmful, error, crash, unresolved, and unclassified occurrences remain visible
all emitted JSON validates by parse and internal reconciliation
endpoint.unit: one syntactic occurrence on one tracked subject blob

extractor.deduplication: exact duplicate detections from the same detector/span/family are collapsed; cross-family membership is retained
extractor.normalization: Unicode text is preserved; semantic grouping trims surrounding whitespace only; case is not changed
extractor.occurrence_identity: sha256(path, detector, byte_start, byte_end, raw_value, semantic_family)

hard_preconditions.predicate: census input commit and tree resolve exactly to frozen subject.git_commit and subject.git_tree; execution branch contains only the pre-outcome freeze commit before parsing
Git tree is readable and every entry is enumerated
freeze commit is an ancestor of the execution result commit
all retained occurrence and file denominators reconcile
unclassified and excluded rows remain in outputs
no manuscript, claim-ledger, authority, PDF, figure, table, or package path changed

leakage_and_censoring_probes.cap_hit: wallclock or blob cap yields explicit CENSORED/CANNOT_CHECK terminal, never completion
leakage_and_censoring_probes.censoring: every non-eligible blob is retained with exact path, object id, byte count, and exclusion reason
leakage_and_censoring_probes.filename_leakage: rerun semantic assignment with path replaced by <MASKED>; assignments must match
leakage_and_censoring_probes.generator_label_leakage: classification uses only raw value and bounded context, never Git author, branch, issue, or generator identity
leakage_and_censoring_probes.shortcut_probe: unknown synthetic composite remains unclassified rather than inferred from path

output_rules.case_outcomes: all file rows and occurrence rows, including exclusions/unclassified/adverse/CANNOT_CHECK
output_rules.raw_manifest: one row per tracked blob plus every extracted occurrence
output_rules.serialization: UTF-8 JSON, sort_keys=true, indent=2, trailing newline

semantic_decomposition.ambiguous_policy: retain every matching coordinate; do not force a single coordinate
semantic_decomposition.assignment_method: deterministic frozen keyword rules over raw value plus bounded local context
semantic_decomposition.cannot_check_policy: CANNOT_CHECK and its reason are retained as an outcome plus unresolved obligation/coverage semantics, never scored as failure or zero
semantic_decomposition.dependency_projection: dependency occurrences map only when frozen coordinate rules support a mapping; unresolved dependency semantics remain unclassified
semantic_decomposition.transition_projection: transition occurrences retain source/target text and map only by frozen coordinate rules
semantic_decomposition.unclassified_policy: retain exact value, occurrence count, paths, contexts, and reason=no_frozen_coordinate_rule_matched

transfer.endpoint: same detector and coordinate rules execute on held-out paths with denominator reconciliation
transfer.interpretation: mechanical rule transfer only; not semantic or external scientific validity
transfer.split: deterministic path-hash split modulo 5; folds 0-3 development census, fold 4 held-out mechanical transfer
